candidates.angle: He calls himself your student, your disciple
He asks you to instruct one who has taken refuge
candidates.evidence: मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् (me, one who has taken refuge)

candidates.angle: His nature is overcome by weakness and his mind is confused

angle_en: Disciple and refuge: the teaching begins
angle_hi: शिष्य और शरण: उपदेश शुरू होता है

en.intro: Arjuna has dropped his bow. Listen for how he stops arguing and calls Krishna his teacher.
en.notice: He calls himself your student, your disciple, and one who has taken refuge. With that single shift, the debate ends and the teaching begins.
en.next: He then lists all the kingdoms and wealth he could win, and finds they cannot touch his grief.
en.meaning: My nature is overwhelmed by weakness, and my mind is confused about duty. I ask you: tell me with certainty what is best for me. I am your student; instruct me, for I have taken refuge in you.

hi.intro: अर्जुन ने अपना धनुष गिरा दिया है। सुनिए, कैसे वे बहस करना बंद करके श्रीकृष्ण को अपना गुरु कहते हैं।
hi.meaning: कायरता के दोष से दबा हुआ स्वभाव और धर्म के विषय में भ्रमित मन लेकर मैं आपसे पूछता हूँ कि मेरे लिए निश्चित कल्याण करने वाला मार्ग कौन सा है। मैं आपका शिष्य हूँ। शरण में आए हुए मुझे शिक्षा दीजिये।
hi.notice: वे स्वयं को आपका शिष्य और शरण में आया हुआ कहते हैं। इसी एक वाक्य से बहस समाप्त होती है और उपदेश शुरू होता है।
hi.next: वे फिर कहते हैं कि यदि उन्हें पृथ्वी पर अजेय राज्य या देवताओं पर भी अधिकार मिल जाए, तब भी उनकी यह शोक की अग्नि शांत नहीं होती।

en.intro: Arjuna has dropped his bow. Listen for how he stops arguing and calls Krishna his teacher.
en.body: My nature is overwhelmed by weakness, and my mind is confused about duty. I ask you: tell me with certainty what is best for me. I am your student; instruct me, for I have taken refuge in you. He calls himself your student, your disciple, and one who has taken refuge. With that single shift, the debate ends and the teaching begins. He then lists all the kingdoms and wealth he could win, and finds they cannot touch his grief.
